data.name: Ages of Conflict: World War Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Chat with us!

Link in the information block ➜


About the Game

AI Simulation with High Customization

In this game you observe customized AI nations battle it out to ultimately try to control the world in a massive free-for-all, featuring alliances, revolts, puppet states and all kinds of political twists!
NOTE: This is not a Strategy Game.

Extensive Map Creator + God Mode Tools

The game comes with premade Maps and Scenarios, but you can unleash your creativity by making your own! Make your maps and borders as complex as you like! Check out hundreds of High Quality Scenarios on Steam Workshop from historical periods to fantasy worlds!

Govern world history by controlling nations directly. Carefully edit borders, terrain, nation stats and AI behaviour at any point during the simulation!

World Building

View the whole History of your simulations and Statistics to get a better view of past events and nations long gone. With the right settings, the world can continue to change for thousands of years.

If you are interested in History, Geography, Map Painting or watching chaos unfold, Ages of Conflict has got you covered!

data.short_description: Ages of Conflict is a versatile Map Simulation game where you create and observe custom AI nations battle it out across an infinite number of worlds. Paint beautiful maps and scenarios, and command nations to change history into your liking!
